text: 金十数据8月29日讯，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅29日同尼泊尔外长希西尔通电话。王毅表示，中方对尼一揽子援助正在落实，包括紧急现汇援助和人道主义援助。中方提供的救灾物资即将运抵加德满都。中方隧道救援专家兵分两路，奔赴灾区和加德满都驰援。中方已同尼方分享灾区影像、卫星和水文数据等重要信息，包括上游堰塞湖预警信息。对在中方一侧滞留的尼泊尔公民，中方已作出妥善安排，将协助他们尽快返尼，感谢并希望尼方继续救助转移在尼的中国公民。中尼是山水相连、命运与共的共同体。面对灾情，两国要坚定站在一起，携手应对，共克时艰，以实际行动诠释跨越喜马拉雅的传统友谊。
text_en: Jin Shi Data, August 29 - Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs, spoke by phone with Nepali Foreign Minister Shishir on the 29th. Wang Yi said China's package of assistance to Nepal is being implemented, including emergency cash aid and humanitarian assistance. Relief supplies provided by China are about to arrive in Kathmandu. Chinese tunnel rescue experts have split into two teams to rush to the disaster zone and Kathmandu. China has shared important information with Nepal, including disaster zone imagery, satellite and hydrological data, and early warnings on upstream barrier lakes. For Nepali citizens stranded on the Chinese side, China has made proper arrangements to help them return to Nepal as soon as possible, and expressed gratitude and hope that Nepal will continue to rescue and transfer Chinese citizens in Nepal. China and Nepal are a community sharing mountains and rivers and a common future. In the face of the disaster, the two countries must stand firmly together, respond jointly, and overcome difficulties, demonstrating the traditional friendship across the Himalayas through concrete actions.
